purpose: Reusable local-memory headroom cases for memory_biocortex_relevance_lift_summary. These cases are selected from recall_eval where baseline FTS finds a relevant memory but does not already rank it first, leaving measurable reorder headroom.

selection_source.db: default agent-bridge state.db on this Mac node
selection_source.selection_rule: include cases whose first relevant FTS hit is present in top_k and baseline_fts_rank_observed > 1

baseline_headroom_contract.note: The relevance-lift evaluator can only prove reorder lift when the relevant source is already in the baseline candidate list; pure misses are separate recall-expansion evidence, not rank-lift evidence.

query_cases.query: codex 的核心工具集和原生能力重叠,该不该因为很少用就降级
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift Codex-native-overlap demotion guidance when FTS already finds an acceptable answer below rank 1.

query_cases.query: 怎么查看 sibling 推到远端的文件内容又不影响我的工作树
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift the safe remote-file inspection lesson from a paraphrased git workflow query.

query_cases.query: 多个 agent 在同一个 git 仓库一起干活 HEAD 争用怎么预防
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift the shared-worktree HEAD contention lesson in a multi-agent coordination query.

query_cases.query: EdgeRazor 那篇论文有什么值得我们借鉴的地方
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift a paper-borrowing memory when a lexical anchor exists but the answer is not rank 1.

query_cases.query: 有没有一个全局通用的 TELLS 基线技能
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift the global TELLS baseline skill memory.

query_cases.query: palace 评审 artifact 从外部工具借鉴了哪些设计模式
query_cases.review_intent: Check whether side-signal reorder can lift Palace artifact design-pattern provenance.

query_cases.query: agent bridge northstar bidirectional bridge vision
query_cases.review_intent: Control case with lexical tokens restored; useful for detecting regressions when the target still fails rank 1.
